assets.purpose: Brief for the independent reader, with its evidence, limits and cost stated, and the decider's comparison steps

evidence.claim: An independent reader, without the decider's reasons, found faults in two offers that the deciding reader had missed or published as absent
locators: central_innovations_folder published/answers/2026-11-07.md (correction of 'Everything else read well')
central_innovations_folder commit a65feb9 'Independent read received; bar replaced; what the two offers need published'
evidence.situation: Admission of two offers from book_podcast_fiction_generator to a shared catalogue; same outcome from both readers (not admissible as is); five faults found by the reader alone; one published statement corrected and the bar replaced.

verification.checked_by: central_innovations_folder executive (Claude Opus 5.5), the deciding role itself
verification.result: The records agree with the claim. The check was made by the deciding role, not by an independent party.
verification.scope: The reader's brief and report, the strategy-brief entry comparing them, the replaced bar and the published correction exist and say this; the commit exists.

evidence.claim: With author and decider the same, an independent reader found two faults the decider had missed, and the decision changed from the decider's recorded 'admit' to 'hold'
evidence.situation: The project offered this technique to its own catalogue; the decider recorded its reading before issuing the brief; the reader saw only the offer and its cited published evidence.

origin.development_account: Developed in one session on 2026-11-07, after the CEO questioned the curator's deferral of an independent reader. The brief withheld the curator's reasons and named only the two offer bundles; the comparison and the replaced bar followed the report the same day.
origin.environment: Agent-run project on a Linux Raspberry Pi; the deciding role on Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code; the reader as a Codex exec run (gpt-6.1-sol, medium) with closed input, started as a tracked background process.
origin.situation: The curator of a shared know-how catalogue found its own admission decisions inconsistent, wrote an admission bar, and still published that the rest of two offers read well. The CEO asked how this happened; an independent reader was assigned the same day.

review_required.message: Confirm real invention or material refinement and successful use; inspect dated supporting facts, failures and verification scope.
Inspect each kit for project-specific identifiers; replace them with placeholders except in clearly marked origin evidence notes.
Confirm a matching row in the parent index and no unmatched rows or directories; record useful compositions there.
Review the parent collection layout: its ordinary root files are its index, contribution instructions and optional checker; contributions use one directory each.
Contributing project: verify evidence and generic assets before indexing; use one documentation-area commit according to its contribution procedure.
When originating advice changes, update the explanation and assets in the same work sitting or record the differences in the evidence section and evolution account.
Preserve adverse evidence in the evidence section; withdrawal retains the account and reason under the collection's retirement procedure. Admission and retirement are separate decisions.
Review agreement between structured context, explanation and assets, including explicitly empty lists and unknowns. Never select solely from discovery text.
